Achievements are granted throughout the game for various merits of small and large scale. They do not unlock anything, but do count towards a Save File's completion percent.

Image Name Description
Shrug It Off Win a battle with 1 HP remaining.
Purity Have 3 or fewer cards in hand, draw, and discard pile combined.
Come At Me Win a combat without playing an Attack.
The Pact Exhaust 20 cards in a single combat.
Adrenaline Have 9 Energy in a single turn of combat.

Notes[]

  • You can still get the Perfect achievement if you lose HP from your own cards during a boss combat.
  • You can still obtain the Minimalist achievement if your deck becomes 5 cards after Act 3.

Tips[]

  • Adrenaline can be easy to get using cards that generate Energy, such as Adrenaline, TURBO, Collect, Deva Form, or by using Ice Cream, which conserves Energy between turns. 
  • The Pact can be earned in combats where the enemies applies many Statuses, such as the fight with the Sentries, or use any combo of Corruption with Dead Branch and/or Dark Embrace.
  • To earn the Purity achievement, you either need a constant source of Exhausting, or a minimalist deck with some Exhaust cards.
    • Facing the Bronze Automaton in Act 2 may also help, as the Bronze Orbs will temporarily remove two cards from your deck.
  • The Impervious and Barricaded achievements can be earned with any source of Block and a way to conserve it between turns, such as Barricade. Entrench makes these achievements much easier and less tedious.
  • Peace Pipe makes the Minimalist challenge easier, as you are given many more card removal opportunities with it.
  • Killing the boss on turn 1 for the You Are Nothing achievement requires a large amount of damage to be done in a single turn. Consider using a highly upgraded Searing Blow, boosters like Offering/Adrenaline/Potions, or an "infinite" deck.
    • Killing the Awakened One's first phase in one turn counts for getting the achievement.
  • The Come At Me achievement is easily earned with Thorns, Poison, or by playing The Defect and letting Orbs chip away.
    • Taking Neow's Lament on The Defect, combined with Orbs is an easy way to get this achievement
  • The Catalyst achievement, as its name implies, is simplified with the use of Catalyst.
  • The Transient is more or less a hard version of "You are nothing". Any build that scales quickly, e.g. via the use of Catalyst, Limit Break, rapid Mantra generation for a consistent Divinity or infinite one-turn killer combo, may beat it.
  • Neon is best earned through the use of Meteor Strike and a way to play it multiple times in one turn, such as Echo Form and/or Hologram.
  • Both Focused and Powerful are best earned with Creative AI as a continuous source of powers.
    • Focused can also be earned through the use of Consume, but will require many orb slots. Best coupled with Inserter.
  • An "infinite" deck containing cards such as Flash of Steel, Dropkick or Heel Hook will make many achievements simple. An infinite can also be built with cards such as Tactician or an Unceasing Top but a deck like this may take longer to kill enemies.
